answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the vertex of a task receipt, and the cedar is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work, idle agents bleed standing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the forge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
